passages.text:
When buying goods and services anywhere in the EU you have the same consumer rights concerning:
- [Contract information](https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/consumers/shopping/contract-information/index_en.htm)
- [Guarantees](https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/consumers/shopping/guarantees/index_en.htm)
- [Commercial guarantee of durability](https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/consumers/shopping/commercial-guarantee-durability/index_en.htm)
- [Returns](https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/consumers/shopping/returns/index_en.htm)
- [Pricing and payments](https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/consumers/shopping/pricing-payments/index_en.htm)
- [Shipping and delivery](https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/consumers/shopping/shipping-delivery/index_en.htm)
- [VAT - Value Added Tax](https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/consumers/shopping/vat/index_en.htm)
As a buyer, it is good to be aware of any safety risks of a product, and to check its energy consumption:
- [Product safety](https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/consumers/shopping/product-safety/index_en.htm)
- [Energy Labels](https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/consumers/shopping/energy-labels/index_en.htm)
See also:
- Your shopping rights - an interactive tool to help you understand your rights when shopping in the EU
- Safety Gate - the EU rapid alert system for dangerous non-food products
